comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-ledger-sqlite (persistence/sqlite/DEPENDENCIES.md). rusqlite 0.41.1 / libsqlite3-sys 0.39.1 adopted 2026-11-12 (RUSTSEC-2026-0459 fixed; release age at least 14 days); other packages as reviewed for M1 (M1-07).

rusqlite.role: direct runtime (SQLite driver; default features off)

libsqlite3-sys.role: transitive (links the pinned SQLite 3.54.1 static library, D-023; the bundled feature must stay off)

smallvec.role: transitive (rusqlite); pinned below 1.16.5 by the 14-day release-age rule (M1-07)

vcpkg.role: build-time only (libsqlite3-sys build script; unused on Linux)
